headline: What Should I Do Immediately After a Car Accident?

publisher.name: Law Office of Angelo J. Reyes, APC

articleBody:
It’s totally normal to feel rattled after a car accident, but taking a few key steps right away can really protect your rights down the line. First off, check for injuries – your own and anyone else involved. If someone's hurt, call 911 immediately. Even if you feel okay, it's a good idea to see a doctor as soon as possible, because some injuries don't show up right away.

Next, if it's safe to do so, move your vehicle out of traffic. Then, exchange information with the other driver: names, contact info, insurance details, and license plate numbers. Don't forget to take plenty of photos and videos of the accident scene, vehicle damage, and any visible injuries. Pictures speak volumes!

It’s super important to avoid discussing fault or apologizing at the scene. Stick to the facts. And remember, contact the police to file an official report, even for minor accidents, especially in San Diego County. This report can be really helpful later on.

Finally, hold off on talking to insurance companies beyond reporting the incident until you’ve had a chance to speak with someone who truly has your best interests at heart. An experienced personal injury attorney, especially one familiar with car accident claims in areas like Carlsbad or Oceanside, can guide you through these initial conversations and make sure you don't inadvertently jeopardize your claim. Getting expert advice early can make a huge difference.
